evidence_rules: Tennis Samoa foundation is anchored to 1955, with historical state naming preserved through independence in 1962 and the 1997 name change.
OTF membership evidence is gated to 2012, not backcast to the federation's foundation.
The 2022 Pacific junior pathway supports current development/competition capacity but is not an outcome-based rating target.
The 2026 OTF profile confirms current federation and junior-development administration only.
Small-state institutional continuity is not treated as world-leading participation or elite depth.
